reason: The customer lease guarantees and credit-support/capacity-purchase commitments are a part or programme of q09's financing-commitments-and-backstops total, held at the same FY2027 year-end and read in the same FY2027 10-K, so 'a part, programme or single deal of a reference total (D248 boundary 1; R2-e)' merges them, as the earlier ruling did for the credit-support programme, and the end-2027 limit does not apply because the date is the same.

Launching Kyber NVL144 is the same event as q18's first shipment of Rubin Ultra in Kyber NVL144 racks (q18's own gold reads 'launch (begin shipping)'), and the 2028 versus 2027 date is 'the same event under another deadline, in either direction (boundary 2)', which applies to an event's date.

A Chinese authorization for AI firms to import H200 chips is the same event q08 asks about, and 2026-12-31 versus 2027-01-31 is 'the same event under another deadline, in either direction (boundary 2)', with 'import-approval process' covered by R2-f for steps of one approval process.

The Kyber rack-scale launch is q18's event (q18's gold includes 'Kyber rack-scale system for Rubin Ultra launch (begin shipping)'), and the 2028 deadline is 'the same event under another deadline, in either direction (boundary 2)', while dropping NVL144 is a variant the check does not rest on (boundary 3, as the earlier NVL576 ruling held).

Chinese approval of H200 imports for named AI companies is the same authorization event that settles q08 (whose gold names the top AI firms), the earlier date is 'another deadline, in either direction (boundary 2)', and 'named companies' is not 'extra scope [that] is its own check and could resolve on its own'.

Both ask for NVIDIA's FY2027 gross margin, settled by the same FY2027 results on the same due day, and the missing 'non-GAAP' qualifier is wording, not one of the two cases where a question 'stays apart only when' (a yes/no signing question beside an amount, or extra scope that is its own separately watched check); the end-2027 limit does not apply because the date is the same.
